title: Effect of irrigation and nitrogen application on grain amino acid composition and protein quality in winter wheat
authors: Zhang P, Ma G, Wang C, Lu H, Li S, Xie Y, Ma D, Zhu Y, Guo T
note: This paper does NOT contain any Zn treatment or Zn concentration data. It studies irrigation (3 levels) and nitrogen application (4 rates: 0, 180, 240, 300 kg N ha-1) effects on grain yield, protein content, amino acid composition, EAAI, and PDCAAS. Cultivar: Yumai 49-198. No Zn observations can be extracted. NOT relevant to Hui 2023 Zn biofortification meta-analysis.
